candidates.claim: CORP_IN entry at fw-01:63 permits tcp/443 from 192.168.30.0/24 to 0.0.0.0/0, which includes OT 10.10.10.0/24, and no earlier entry matches it, so the permit is effective on the corp interface bound at fw-01:102 and CORP can open tcp/443 connections into OT.
candidates.remediation: Restrict CORP_IN entry at fw-01:63 so its destination excludes OT (10.10.10.0/24) and MGMT, or delete it if no approved CORP service requires it.

candidates.remediation: Restrict CORP_IN entry at fw-01:64 so its destination excludes OT (10.10.10.0/24) and MGMT, or delete it.

candidates.claim: CORP_IN entry at fw-01:63 lets CORP reach OT on tcp/443 directly, bypassing the DMZ, because the permit is effective on the corp interface bound at fw-01:102 and tcp/443 into OT is not an approved cross-zone service.
candidates.remediation: Remove the direct CORP-to-OT path so that CORP-to-OT traffic is limited to the approved DMZ-mediated services.
